author: Fevilz_
quote: The Worst GTA Ever! Honestly, GTA 6 is a massive disappointment. The hype is completely unnecessary, and I expected much more. The graphics look overrated, the waiting time is ridiculous, and Rockstar TOOK 13 YEARS to release it. What a waste of time and excitement. Definitely not worth the hype. 0/10. It doesn’t feel like gta no more it’s like a dating simulator Weird animations not realistic it’s garbage I Would not recommend.
